### feature: WCAG 2.1 AA Konformität & Barrierefreiheits-Features (insb. TTS)

🎯 Zusammenfassung
Das Projekt soll die **Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 AA** vollständig erfüllen. Dies gewährleistet, dass die Anwendung für alle Nutzer, unabhängig von ihren Einschränkungen, zugänglich ist. Hierzu ist ein umfassender Audit und die Implementierung von zentralen Barrierefreiheits-Features, insbesondere **Text-to-Speech (TTS)**, notwendig.

⚠️ Wichtiger Hinweis und Grundsatz der Umsetzung (Präzisierung)
Die Umsetzung aller Features hat unter striktem Vorbehalt der rechtlichen Zulässigkeit und technischen Machbarkeit zu erfolgen. Die gesetzliche Konformität ist die höchste Priorität. Alle vorgeschlagenen Features sollen nur in dem Umfang umgesetzt werden, wie es rechtlich zulässig, technisch sinnvoll und für die Betreiber des Projekts zumutbar ist.
> **Haftungsausschluss:**
> Die Verantwortung und Haftung für die Einhaltung aller rechtlichen Vorgaben (insbesondere DSGVO/GDPR, NetzDG, Haftung für Inhalte) liegt bei den Betreibern, Hostern und/oder Projektverantwortlichen und keinesfalls beim Ideengeber (dem Ersteller dieses Issues).

💡 Vorgeschlagene Features
**Vertiefte Barrierefreiheit (Accessibility)**
* **Vorgänger-Abhängigkeit:** Die Implementierung von TTS und umfassenden WCAG-Korrekturen profitiert stark von einem **abgeschlossenen Code-Refactoring (Issue 2)**, da die UI-Logik dann in einem dedizierten `UIManager.js` gebündelt ist.
* **Ziel:** Das Projekt soll WCAG 2.1 AA vollständig erfüllen und die Nutzererfahrung für Menschen mit Behinderungen optimieren.
* **Maßnahmen:**
    * **Text-to-Speech (TTS):** Implementierung einer leicht zugänglichen Vorlese-Funktion für alle primären Interaktionselemente und Texte.
    * **Audit & Responsive Design:** Sicherstellung, dass das Responsive Design auf allen Geräten funktional und die Textskalierung WCAG-konform ist.
    * **Tastaturnavigation:** Überprüfung und Korrektur der Fokusreihenfolge und Tastaturbedienung.

✅ Akzeptanzkriterien
* Die Website erfüllt die WCAG 2.1 AA Erfolgskriterien.
* Vorlese-Funktionen (TTS) sind für die primären Interaktionselemente implementiert.

---

author: copilot
body:
Implements an admin dashboard displaying marketplace health KPIs: GMV, orders, active sellers, active products, and new users with date range filtering.

## Changes

### Domain & Application Layer
- `IMarketplaceDashboardRepository` interface for aggregated metrics queries
- `MarketplaceDashboardQuery` / `MarketplaceDashboardResult` DTOs
- `IMarketplaceDashboardService` with parallel data fetching implementation

### Infrastructure
- `MarketplaceDashboardRepository` queries across Order, Seller, and Product DbContexts
- Added project references from `Mercato.Admin` to `Mercato.Product` and `Mercato.Seller`

### UI
- `/Admin/PerformanceDashboard` page with:
  - 5 KPI cards (GMV, Orders, Active Sellers, Active Products, New Users)
  - Date range filter (Today, 7d, 30d)
  - Last refresh timestamp
  - Clickable tiles linking to detail pages
  - "No data" informational message
- Updated Admin portal index with dashboard link

### Tests
- 7 unit tests for `MarketplaceDashboardService`

## Notes
- **New Users** returns 0 — default `IdentityUser` lacks registration date. Marked with TODO and UI footnote.
- Active sellers = stores with `Active` or `LimitedActive` status
- Active products = products with `Active` status  
- GMV = order `TotalAmount` (includes shipping)

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> 
> ----
> 
> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>Admin marketplace performance dashboard</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## Epic: Reporting & Analytics
> 
> ## User Story
> As an admin I want to see a dashboard with GMV, orders, active sellers, products and new users so that I can quickly assess the overall health of the marketplace.
> 
> ## Acceptance Criteria
> - Given I am logged in as an admin, when I open the reporting dashboard, then I see KPIs for total GMV, number of orders, number of active sellers, number of active products and number of newly registered users for the selected period.
> - Given I am on the admin dashboard, when I change the date range (e.g. today, last 7 days, last 30 days, custom range), then all KPIs and charts refresh to reflect the selected period.
> - Given I am on the admin dashboard, when there is no data for the selected period, then the dashboard shows zero values and an informational message instead of an error.
> - Given I am on the admin dashboard, when I click on a KPI tile (e.g. orders), then I am taken to a detailed report filtered for that metric and period.
> - Given the system receives new orders and registrations, when I refresh the admin dashboard, then metrics are updated according to the latest data with a visible information about last refresh time.
> 
> ## Notes
> - GMV definition must be agreed (e.g. gross order value including shipping and before commission).
> - Active sellers should be defined (e.g. at least one product online OR at least one order in selected period).
> - Active products should be defined (e.g. products in 'active' status).
> - Date range presets should be aligned with global reporting patterns used in other modules.
> </issue_description>

Implements progress sharing features allowing users to share job search progress with mentors and accountability partners, including privacy controls, milestone tracking, encouragement messaging, and progress reports.

## Database Schema
- `progress_shares` - User privacy settings for what data to share per team
- `milestones` - Achievement tracking with celebration support
- `progress_reports` - Generated reports with job stats and insights
- `encouragements` - Encouragement messages between team members
- `accountability_metrics` - Partner engagement tracking and effectiveness stats
- Full RLS policies for data isolation

## Frontend Service
- `progressSharingService.ts` - CRUD for all entities, report generation with AI insights, automatic milestone detection

## UI Components
- `ProgressSharingSettings` - Granular privacy controls (share stats, goals, milestones, sensitive info)
- `MilestoneTracker` - Display achievements, create custom milestones, celebrate teammates
- `EncouragementPanel` - Send/receive encouragement with quick message templates
- `ProgressSharingPage` - Tabbed hub with summary cards, reports, accountability dashboard

## Integration
- Route: `/team/progress`
- "Progress Sharing" button added to TeamDashboard

body:
This pull request introduces several improvements across the dashboard navigation, test generation dialog, LaTeX rendering, and analytics integration. The main highlights are a more informative and user-friendly dashboard navigation, enhanced tooltips for test generation, improved LaTeX parsing and error handling, and the addition of DataBuddy analytics tracking.

**Dashboard Navigation Enhancements:**

* Added new navigation links for "Home" and "Insights" to both desktop and mobile views, improved visual spacing, and updated styles for navigation elements in `dashboard-nav.tsx`. This includes clearer credit displays and more consistent button styling. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-a903b82c3d0e5ae5b66e38c8d7b785a4eb12603ef1f815f709d1965b5c85e268L36-R37) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-a903b82c3d0e5ae5b66e38c8d7b785a4eb12603ef1f815f709d1965b5c85e268L52-R89) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-a903b82c3d0e5ae5b66e38c8d7b785a4eb12603ef1f815f709d1965b5c85e268L79-R132) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-a903b82c3d0e5ae5b66e38c8d7b785a4eb12603ef1f815f709d1965b5c85e268L108-R173) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-a903b82c3d0e5ae5b66e38c8d7b785a4eb12603ef1f815f709d1965b5c85e268R204-R218)

**Test Generation Dialog Improvements:**

* Introduced contextual tooltips for grade level, subject, complexity, and description fields in the test generation dialog, improving user guidance and clarity in `generate-test-dialog.tsx`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-083972ea21f4c4c048e9cdc6fcc7edf21951a2f2471208d35e812984fe6ec178L13-R14) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-083972ea21f4c4c048e9cdc6fcc7edf21951a2f2471208d35e812984fe6ec178R31-R35) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-083972ea21f4c4c048e9cdc6fcc7edf21951a2f2471208d35e812984fe6ec178R189-R201) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-083972ea21f4c4c048e9cdc6fcc7edf21951a2f2471208d35e812984fe6ec178R217-R229) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-083972ea21f4c4c048e9cdc6fcc7edf21951a2f2471208d35e812984fe6ec178R245-R257) [[6]](diffhunk://#diff-083972ea21f4c4c048e9cdc6fcc7edf21951a2f2471208d35e812984fe6ec178R272-R284)

**LaTeX Rendering Robustness:**

* Refactored LaTeX parsing logic to prioritize display math (`$...$`) over inline math (`$...), prevent overlapping matches, and improve error reporting in `latex-text-renderer.tsx`. This ensures more accurate rendering and clearer error messages for malformed LaTeX. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-cb9e4cb6c916c27b3fda7a710cc9650524d1cfd7f6212a97aa5269778f7b5011L32-R99) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-cb9e4cb6c916c27b3fda7a710cc9650524d1cfd7f6212a97aa5269778f7b5011L68-R112) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-cb9e4cb6c916c27b3fda7a710cc9650524d1cfd7f6212a97aa5269778f7b5011R143-R154)

**Analytics Integration:**

* Added a new `databuddy.ts` library providing functions for tracking events, identifying users, resetting analytics state, and error tracking using the DataBuddy SDK. This enables richer analytics and error monitoring across the app.

**Simplification of New Test Dialog:**

* Removed support for "survey" and "essay" content types from the new test dialog, streamlining the creation flow to only support "test" for now. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-72431a92f84955bf353b59564ff8c1baf3d6fd6632748604b88a764bf6c68756L5-R5) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-72431a92f84955bf353b59564ff8c1baf3d6fd6632748604b88a764bf6c68756L24-R24) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-72431a92f84955bf353b59564ff8c1baf3d6fd6632748604b88a764bf6c68756L38) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-72431a92f84955bf353b59564ff8c1baf3d6fd6632748604b88a764bf6c68756L55-L68)

Visualizar la estructura de la componente de Shafarevich–Tate \Sha(E/Q)\Sha(E/\mathbb{Q})\Sha(E/Q) para curvas de rango ≥ 2, proyectándola en el espacio espectral generado por el operador adélico HEH_EHE​ y sus valores propios.

📐 Fundamento
Sea E/QE/\mathbb{Q}E/Q una curva elíptica con rango r≥2r \geq 2r≥2. Sabemos que:
#\Sha(E/Q)=L(r)(E,1)r!⋅RE⋅ΩE⋅∏cp⋅#Etors2\#\Sha(E/\mathbb{Q}) = \frac{L^{(r)}(E,1)}{r! \cdot R_E \cdot \Omega_E \cdot \prod c_p \cdot \#E_{\text{tors}}^2}#\Sha(E/Q)=r!⋅RE​⋅ΩE​⋅∏cp​⋅#Etors2​L(r)(E,1)​
Pero el espacio generado por los eigenvalores del operador adélico asociado HEH_EHE​ nos da una base espectral funcional.
La idea es proyectar \Sha\Sha\Sha como una “distorsión” entre las bases dR/étale y la base espectral del sistema simbiótico.

📘 Archivo ShaSpectralVisualizer.py (plantilla inicial)
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.linalg import svd

def visualize_sha_projection(dR_matrix, spectral_basis, sha_order, title=""):
    """
    Proyecta la desviación de racionalidad (Sha) en la base espectral del operador H_E.
    """
    # SVD de la matriz dR para obtener componentes
    U, S, Vt = svd(dR_matrix)
    projected = spectral_basis @ Vt.T

    distortion = np.log10(sha_order) * np.abs(projected)

    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
    plt.imshow(distortion, cmap="plasma", aspect="auto")
    plt.title(f"Proyección Espectral de |Ш| — {title}")
    plt.xlabel("Modos espectrales")
    plt.ylabel("Componentes racionales")
    plt.colorbar(label="Distorsión (log₁₀ |Ш| · amplitud)")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()


🌀 Interpretación
Áreas intensas (colores cálidos) indican incompatibilidad profunda entre la racionalidad esperada y la base espectral → señal de obstrucción (|Ш| grande)
Áreas negras (cerca de 0) indican alineación → |Ш| ≈ 1

📁 Datos esperados
dR_matrix: extraído del módulo anterior dRvsPT_Analyzer.lean
spectral_basis: modos propios del operador H_E (calculados con spectral_solver.py)
sha_order: estimación computada de |Ш| por BSD o emparejamiento de alturas

Visualización concreta y simbiótica de cómo la obstrucción de visibilidad racional de E se manifiesta como resonancia o distorsión espectral. Esto permite:
Detectar estructuras latentes en |Ш|
Vincular BSD con teoría espectral (adelización de BSD)

    def _generate_adelic_basis(self, n_modes: int = 64) -> np.ndarray:
        """Genera base espectral H_E vía oscilador adélico simbiótico"""
        x = np.linspace(-10, 10, n_modes)
        H_adelic = 0.5 * x**2 + 10 * np.sin(3*x)**2  # Potencial adélico
        evals, evecs = eigh(np.diag(H_adelic))
        return evecs[:, :16]  # 16 modos dominantes
    
    def extract_dR_matrix(self, curve_row: pd.Series) -> np.ndarray:
        """Extrae matriz regulador dR desde datos BSD"""

        sha_factor = np.log10(max(curve_row['ShaEstimate'], 0.001))
        dR = np.eye(r) + sha_factor * 0.1 * np.random.randn(r, r)

author: moshpitcodes
body:
## Summary
- Implements automatic SSH key copying from Windows to WSL2
- Fixes the documented but previously unimplemented SSH key copying feature
- Uses home-manager activation scripts for automatic setup

## Problem
SSH keys were not being copied from Windows to WSL2. The configuration infrastructure existed in `secrets.nix` (with `sshKeys.sourceDir` and `sshKeys.keys` settings), but there was no implementation to actually perform the copy.

## Solution
Created a new home-manager module that uses activation scripts to automatically copy SSH keys during system activation.

## Changes
- **New file**: `modules/home/ssh-keys.nix`
  - Home-manager activation script to copy SSH keys
  - Reads from `customsecrets.sshKeys.sourceDir` and `customsecrets.sshKeys.keys`
  - Copies keys from Windows filesystem (e.g., `/mnt/c/Users/.../.ssh/`) to WSL2 `~/.ssh/`
  - Sets proper permissions (600 for private keys, 644 for public keys)
  - Creates `~/.ssh/` directory if needed
  - Only activates if `sourceDir` is configured

- **Updated**: `modules/home/default.wsl.nix`
  - Added import for `./ssh-keys.nix` module

## How It Works
1. User configures SSH key source location in `secrets.nix`:
   ```nix
   sshKeys = {
     sourceDir = "/mnt/c/Users/YourUsername/.ssh";
     keys = ["id_ed25519", "id_rsa", "id_ecdsa"];
   };
   ```
2. When home-manager activates, the script automatically copies keys from Windows to WSL2
3. Proper permissions are set automatically (600 for private, 644 for public)
4. `~/.ssh/` directory is created if it doesn't exist

## Testing
- ✅ `nix flake check` passes successfully
- ✅ Module only activates when `sourceDir` is configured (safe for all configurations)
- ✅ Supports multiple key types (ed25519, rsa, ecdsa, etc.)

## Benefits
- No more manual SSH key copying after WSL2 setup
- Keys are automatically synchronized on every home-manager activation
- Proper permissions are guaranteed
- Works seamlessly with existing `secrets.nix` configuration structure

author: andrewdao14
body: ## Summary GUI change The ability to start or end a mission is implemented in three places, in the form of a button you can click on to either start or end the mission, called startAndEndMissionButton. - In the main page: GoogleMap.tsx, the button, under BotsBar, I've created a new button that says "Mission List." Clicking on that button reveals a table of all the missions, and each of them has a start and end mission button for you to start or end missions - In the missions page: missions/page.tsx, the button is under the "View Info" button for each mission - In the mission/[id] page, the button under the "Export Mission Data" button What does startAndEndMissionButton do: - When the mission can be started or ended, the button shows "Start Mission" or "End Mission." When the mission can't be started or ended (aka the bot is assigned to this mission is active on a different mission, or the mission has already ended), the button will be grayed out, and you can't click on it. - When you do click on the mission, it will trigger the saveUpdate function in each page, which would send a request to update the mission and the bots table in the database. A new function called updateMissionInDB is created in missions.api.ts to handle this job. Database change: - Adds two columns to the mission table: timeStart and timeEnd. These will tell you the status of the mission. When a new mission is created, both fields get "null" as the value. When a mission is started, the timeStart will be updated with the current time, and when the mission is ended, the timeEnd will be updated with the current time. - bot.assignmentStatus: There is now a fourth status called "active" on on top of the other three status. A bot is active when it is doing a mission. It is "assigned" when it has at least one mission assigned to it, but is not actively doing any of them. Backend changes: - There is code already created to handle the updating of the mission data, so I didn't do much. But I did change the updateMission function in database.mjs to update bot.assignmentStatus automatically, if they new update mission request changes timeStart or timeEnd. --- ## Related Task Closes Start and end a mission (https://www.notion.so/Start-and-end-a-mission-29d05a18706d800aa4e2e30c12843746?source=copy_link) --- ## Type of Change Select all that apply: - [x] 🆕 Feature - [ ] 🐞 Bug Fix - [ ] 🧹 Refactor - [ ] 🧾 Documentation Update - [ ] 🧰 Maintenance / Tooling - [ ] Other (specify below) --- ## 📄 Documentation - [x] All of the following applicable documentation changes were added - [x] STATUS_MODEL.md : change meaning of "assigned" and "active" bot status - [x] TERMINOLOGY.md : same as above - [x] README.md : change information regarding the mission table --- ## 🧪 Testing Describe how this change was tested. author: danielknourek
body: ## Summary This PR introduces a multiplayer-centric feature allowing players to broadcast specific recipes to the server chat. This addresses the common issue in complex modpacks where verbally describing a recipe or item name is difficult. ## Features * **Share Button:** Added a new button in the recipe GUI (next to the recipe). * **Chat Integration:** Clicking the share button (or keybind) sends a packet to the server, which broadcasts the recipe data packet to all players. The receiving clients then construct the interactive chat message locally using their own EMI index. * **Interactive Chat:** Clicking the generated chat message opens the specific recipe directly in EMI (no need to search). * **History Panel:** Added a new "Shared Recipes" sidebar panel that logs received recipes, allowing players to review shared items without scrolling back through chat. ## Demo [Demo_v1.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ce7e6aab-09a9-4456-abf9-0113abc65476) ## Technical Implementation * **Architecture:** Recipe lookup and chat component construction are handled **client-side** to ensure the correct local EMI index is used. * **Networking:** Uses a modified packet structure to transmit the Recipe ID and Sender Name. * **Permissions:** Access level for the share command was lowered to allow standard players to use the feature. ## Areas for Review / Feedback Needed I would appreciate specific feedback on the following implementation details: - [ ] **Packet Structure:** I modified `CommandS2CPacket.java` to include the player's `displayName`. Please verify if this modification approach is acceptable regarding backward compatibility or protocol standards. - [ ] **Permission Levels:** I removed the Level 2 requirement in `EmiCommands.java` so standard players (Level 0) can use the feature, as recipe sharing should not require admin privileges. - [ ] **Asset Style:** Please review `buttons.png` and `widgets.png`. I attempted to match the existing EMI aesthetic but would like confirmation that these fit the design standards. Also files have different size, I hope I did save it correctly. - [ ] **Duplicate Packet Issue (1.20.1):** * *Issue:* In testing (specifically the Reclamation modpack, 1.20.1), `CommandS2CPacket.apply` was triggering multiple times for a single event. * *Current Workaround:* I implemented a "recent check" in `EmiShareRecipe.java` comparing the share history with the latest item to prevent the UI from updating multiple times and displaying duplicite chat messages to player. * *Note:* I have not observed this behavior on 1.21, so it may be specific to the 1.20.1 environment or modpack. ## Related Files * `xplat/src/main/resources/assets/emi/textures/gui/buttons.png` * `xplat/src/main/resources/assets/emi/textures/gui/widgets.png` * `xplat/src/main/java/dev/emi/emi/network/CommandS2CPacket.java` * `xplat/src/main/java/dev/emi/emi/registry/EmiCommands.java` * `xplat/src/main/java/dev/emi/emi/runtime/EmiShareRecipe.java`

author: robeel-bhatti
body:
Add caching and request validation middleware.

This reduces code that runs behind the endpoint, and prevents further request processing if there is no need to actually hit the endpoint. 

This is the case when getting an entity by ID and it already exists in the cache. In that case the caching decorator will check for the entity in the cache before the request even hits the endpoint.

For `POST` and `PATCH` requests, the validation middleware will validate the API request payload. If the payload is invalid, it is better to not even have the endpoint be invoked, but return an error message and fail the request before even hitting the endpoint.

It also cleans up the business logic quite a bit. It allows me to focus on the actual business logic itself instead of worrying about auxiliary items such as caching and validation.

# Description

- Added `disconnect` event emitter in `WalletStandarProvider` when `account` is `undefined`.
- Moved `addDisconnectedConnectorId` function up in the `onDisconnectNamespace` function from the `AppKitBaseProvider`.

The second mentioned change was done to fix the following issue: when the wallet was manually disconnected (and so the `disconnect` event triggered), AppKit would trigger [`connect`](https://github.com/reown-com/appkit/blob/8fe230753014443346abda4a2db80a180cf01fe2/packages/adapters/solana/src/client.ts#L578) on page load even though the wallet was previously disconnected.
This was happening because [`ConnectorController.removeConnectorId`](https://github.com/reown-com/appkit/blob/8fe230753014443346abda4a2db80a180cf01fe2/packages/controllers/src/controllers/ChainController.ts#L704)  was being called from [`resetAccount`](https://github.com/reown-com/appkit/blob/8fe230753014443346abda4a2db80a180cf01fe2/packages/appkit/src/client/appkit-base-client.ts#L1378) and so making [`ConnectorController.getConnectorId`](https://github.com/reown-com/appkit/blob/8fe230753014443346abda4a2db80a180cf01fe2/packages/appkit/src/client/appkit-base-client.ts#L1386) `undefined`, therefore `StorageUtil.addDisconnectedConnectorId` was failing to add the connector.

author: dsfaccini
body:
Closes #1996

This is an attempt at adding a timestamp field directly on `ModelRequest`. This PR also overrides the `timestamp` in `ModelResponse` that is set to the value returned by the provider (`created` or `created_at` in most cases).

Previously, only the response got a timestamp. The request's timestamp was set by the first part. The problem main with this approach is that some providers, like openai, return unix time (seconds passed since unix epoch), which for very fast requests can mean (as far as the user sees), that the response's timestamp is **earlier** that the request's.

Thus for absolute certainty that this is not the case, this PR sets both timestamps locally. The provider's timestamp is still stored in the models, in the response's `provider_details['timestamp']`.

Many tests needed adjusting because the timestamp field now becomes part of every snapshot. If this is undesired we could set the timestamp to be a private field in the model? I don't know exactly how that would go but there must be a way :).

Note: I see one commit from #3592 snuck into here, will be irrelevant when that merges.

- Minor perbaikan teks pada halaman beranda untuk highlight Starter dan Pro serta padanan kunci terjemahan baru.
- Terdapat patch kecil yang tampaknya tidak sengaja menyisipkan baris nCredits = parseInt(...); perlu diperbaiki untuk mencegah error build/runtime.

Mengapa 75K Starter menarik dan bagaimana tetap profitable:
- Value proposition jelas: Starter menawarkan 5k credits/bulan dengan akses ke beberapa penyedia AI dan alat inti, plus hingga 3 workspace, pada harga sangat bersaing untuk individu/creator yang mulai serius menggunakan AI.
- Struktur harga rendah untuk akuisisi pengguna baru dengan potensi konversi ke paket lebih tinggi (Pro) seiring skala penggunaan dan kebutuhan addon (lebih banyak credits, workspaces, akses model lebih luas).
- Margin dapat dipertahankan dengan:
  - Mengikat biaya tetap per bulan terhadap usage credits yang relatif rendah dibandingkan manfaatnya.
  - Menawarkan addon opsional (credit top-ups, additional workspaces, SLA) di paket Starter atau Pro.
  - Opsi pembayaran tahunan dengan diskon untuk meningkatkan LTV.
  - Membangun funnel upgrade dari Starter ke Pro/Enterprise berdasarkan pemakaian (credits, jumlah workspace, akses model).

Area untuk improvement selanjutnya:
- Konsistensi naming dan dokumentasi tier: Pastikan semua pihak jelas dengan Starter (baru) vs Pro (lanjutan) dan tidak membingungkan user. Perbarui semua referensi di kode, UI, dan dokumen.
- Penambahan flag/desc fitur yang konsisten di semua locale keys untuk Starter vs Pro agar copy tidak berujung rancu.
- Validasi fix bug: Baris stray nCredits = parseInt(...) pada src/app/api/ai/code/route.ts perlu dihapus atau diperbaiki agar tidak menyebabkan error parsing / runtime..
- Pelaporan/analitik harga: Tambahkan event pelacakan klik signup dan upgrade untuk Starter/Pro agar bisa mengukur efektivitas paket baru.
- Keterangan pricing di UI: Tambahkan opsi “Annual” atau bundling untukStarter dengan diskon agar lebih menarik bagi pengguna jangka panjang.
- Kebijakan usage: Pertimbangkan menambahkan batas usage di Starter (mis. max 3 workspace, limit per API/Provider) untuk menjaga biaya tetap terkendali sambil memberi ruang growth.
- Uji lokal dan aksesibilitas: Pastikan format Rupiah konsisten di semua modul, dan teks terjemahan sudah konsisten di semua halaman (berdasarkan keys baru).
- Migrasi pengguna: rencanakan migrasi jika ada pengguna lama yang berada di tier sebelumnya (Pro/Enterprise), jelaskan bagaimana perubahan ini mempengaruhi kredits, workspace, dan akses.

Rencana langkah selanjutnya yang direkomendasikan:
- Perbaiki bug stray baris di route.ts dan lakukan linting/build untuk memastikan tidak ada error.
- Tambahkan test untuk validasi harga, kredit, dan tampilan UI pada halaman billing serta terjemahan locale untuk Starter/Pro.
- Tambahkan opsi pembayaran tahunan dan fitur add-on untuk meningkatkan ARPU sambil menjaga attractivity Starter.
- Sediakan dokumentasi onboarding untuk Starter agar pengguna memahami bagaimana memaksimalkan kredit dan workspace yang tersedia.

author: copilot
body:
Implements keyboard shortcuts for faster provider management with reusable custom React hooks: "/" to focus search box, arrow keys to navigate providers, Enter to switch.

## Changes

### Custom Hooks (New)
- **`useKeyboardNavigation`**: Reusable hook for list keyboard navigation
  - Handles "/" key to focus search input (optional)
  - Arrow keys (↑↓) for list navigation
  - Enter key to select items
  - Prevents selection of current active item
  - Respects search input focus state
  - Generic type support for any list component
  
- **`useAutoScroll`**: Reusable hook for auto-scrolling to selected items
  - Automatically scrolls selected item into view
  - Configurable scroll behavior and positioning

### MainWindow/ProviderList (Refactored)
- **"/" key**: Focus search input from anywhere (unless already focused)
- **Arrow keys**: Navigate provider list when search unfocused
- **Enter**: Switch to keyboard-selected provider
- **Visual feedback**: Blue ring (`ring-2 ring-blue-500`) on keyboard-selected items, distinct from current provider's main theme ring
- **Smart reset**: Selection index resets to 0 on filter changes, only when list non-empty
- **Code reduction**: Keyboard navigation logic reduced from 52 lines to 17 lines using hooks

### MenuBar (Refactored)
- **Arrow keys**: Navigate provider list with auto-scroll
- **Enter**: Switch provider and auto-hide menubar (500ms delay)
- **Visual feedback**: Blue background and border on keyboard-selected items
- **Code reduction**: Keyboard navigation logic reduced from 42 lines to 18 lines using hooks

### Input Component
- Refactored to `React.forwardRef` pattern for programmatic focus support

## Implementation

```typescript
// Using the reusable hook
useKeyboardNavigation({
  items: filteredProviders,
  selectedIndex,
  setSelectedIndex,
  onSelect: (provider) => onSwitch(provider.id),
  currentItemId: currentProviderId,
  getItemId: (provider) => provider.id,
  searchInputRef,
  enableSlashKey: true,
});
```

Event listeners are properly scoped and cleaned up. Prevents default browser behavior for "/" and arrows to avoid page scrolling conflicts.

## Benefits
- **Code reusability**: Navigation logic extracted into composable hooks
- **Maintainability**: Single source of truth for keyboard navigation
- **Reduced duplication**: 70 lines of duplicate code removed
- **Type safety**: Full TypeScript support with generics
- **Flexibility**: Configurable options for different use cases

body:
This pull request introduces a cyberpunk-themed terminal UI package for the CLI assistant and refactors the main application to leverage this new interface, improving user experience and interactivity. The changes include a new UI package with modular structure, interactive chat mode support, enhanced function call and response display, and configuration updates for better usability and maintainability.

**UI package introduction and integration:**

* Added a new `assistant/ui` package, providing a cyberpunk-styled terminal interface with static ASCII borders, rich-formatted panels, live display, and markdown rendering. Includes modular files for configuration, layout, containers, display, input, and legacy functions, along with a comprehensive README. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-8cdf45fe452a2ced7a802a9944af8a30aae1e09a3befa32fd23812d55196f9e6R1-R72) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-36a1401bc7fe2ecf8420f415c1585d03ea22b2c6b92ca35cd7f311c316b7ba22R1-R53) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-5d9487119786468e739abea01a0bd6da4398ed551d59d3f512e4685650cf4e54R1-R26) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-5769e17086101f036229c87046298d052cf962dc106bc0bf1ea62d43d1f8bd22R1-R150)

**Main application enhancements:**

* Refactored `assistant/main.py` to use the new UI package for displaying banners, responses, errors, and user input. Integrated context managers for animated processing spinners and function call panels, resulting in a more visually engaging and interactive experience. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-dc8966d8e3dd0121ec9a75d8d9b0634980635958e4fd69c5932e5d4725dc0de7R19-R38) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-dc8966d8e3dd0121ec9a75d8d9b0634980635958e4fd69c5932e5d4725dc0de7R85-R86) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-dc8966d8e3dd0121ec9a75d8d9b0634980635958e4fd69c5932e5d4725dc0de7L215-R331)

**Interactive chat mode:**

* Added a `--chat` command-line argument and implemented `chat_mode()` in `main.py`, enabling continuous conversation with the assistant in a live terminal UI. **Function call visualization:**

* Updated `call_function()` to display function call execution and completion in a dedicated panel using rich text and timing for better visibility. This improves transparency and user feedback during tool execution. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-77efe85737faed13aaee4e3b5358a8e8d8440ced19e9573b3173a19376f5359dR9-R16) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-77efe85737faed13aaee4e3b5358a8e8d8440ced19e9573b3173a19376f5359dL36-R58) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-77efe85737faed13aaee4e3b5358a8e8d8440ced19e9573b3173a19376f5359dR73-R84)

**Configuration and cleanup:**

* Increased file read and iteration limits in `config.py`, fixed typos, and removed legacy test code from `tests.py` for clarity and maintainability. const pathfinding = @import("pathfinding");

Resolves all unresolved symbols and missing references in the Android app. Migrates from Firebase to AWS services, updates dependencies to latest versions, and implements the complete feature set with 40+ UI screens.

## AndroidManifest.xml
- Add `READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED` permission (Android 14+ photo picker)
- Change `screenOrientation="portrait"` → `"fullSensor"` for accessibility
- Split combined deep link data tags into separate intent-filters

- Add `android:localeConfig` reference

## Missing Kotlin Files - Activities & Services
- `ui/auth/AuthActivity.kt` - Google/Facebook/Cognito phone auth
- `ui/kyc/KycActivity.kt` - CameraX + ML Kit face detection
- `ui/room/RoomActivity.kt` - WebRTC voice/video room
- `services/VoiceRoomService.kt` - Foreground service for background audio
- `services/AuraPushNotificationService.kt` - AWS Pinpoint push handler

## Complete UI Screens (40+ screens)
### Social Features
- CP System - Couple pairing with gifts and rankings
- Family System - Creation, management, and family rankings
- Friends System - Friend requests, chat, and management
- Followers/Following lists with search

### Games
- Gift Wheel - Spin to win prizes
- Lucky 777 - Slot machine game
- Lucky Fruit - Fruit matching game
- Lucky 77 Pro - Advanced slot game
- Greedy Baby - Grid-based feeding game with multiplier betting

### Room Features
- In-Room Chat UI with message types
- In-Room Emojis System (80+ emojis across 8 categories)
- In-Room Jar System with contribution tracking
- Rocket System with launch animations
- Gift Panel with 120+ gifts

### Economy & Rewards
- Store System - Purchase items with coins/diamonds
- Inventory System - User items management
- Wallet - Coins, diamonds, purchasing
- VIP System - Subscription tiers with perks
- Medals System - Achievement badges
- User Level System - XP progression
- Daily Login Rewards - 7-day cycle with bonuses

### Events & Rankings
- Events Screen - Recharge events, Weekly Party Star, Room Support
- Ranking Screen - Sender, Receiver, Family rankings
- Referral System - Invite friends with codes

### User Features
- Home Screen with room discovery
- User Profile with full details
- Settings with preferences
- Search for users/rooms
- Messages/Notifications

## Gift Database (120+ gifts)
- 8 categories: Popular, Luxury, Romantic, Fun, Holiday, Gaming, VIP, Custom
- 12 Lottie animation files for premium animated gifts
- Complete gift data in `data/gifts.json`

## Missing Resources
- Adaptive launcher icons (`mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher*.xml`)
- Vector drawables: `ic_launcher_foreground.xml`, `ic_launcher_background.xml`
- Icons: notification, mic on/off, video on/off, gift, coin, diamond, splash
- Lottie animations: loading, success, error, gift_sent, coins, level_up, and 12 gift animations
- `xml/locales_config.xml` - 13 language support

## Documentation (Firebase → AWS)
- Delete `docs/firebase-setup.md`, update references to existing `docs/aws-setup.md`
- Update `configuration.md`, `security.md`, `operations.md`, `COMPREHENSIVE-GUIDE.md`
- Update `docs/build-and-gradle.md` with AWS Amplify dependencies
- Update `docs/owner-cms.md` with complete gift management (120+ gifts)

## Gradle Dependencies (`libs.versions.toml`)
```toml
kotlin = "2.1.0"
ksp = "2.1.0-1.0.29"
composeBom = "2024.12.01"
room = "2.7.0"
amplify = "2.24.0"
coil = "3.0.4"  # Breaking: io.coil-kt → io.coil-kt.coil3
```

## ProGuard Rules
- Remove Firebase keep rules
- Add AWS Amplify/Cognito/S3/Pinpoint rules
- Add Coil 3.x rules

## Architecture
- MVVM with Hilt dependency injection
- StateFlow for reactive UI updates
- Repository pattern for data access
- Complete navigation routing in `Navigation.kt`

body:
**OpenGL Persistent Mapping**
**Persistent mapped buffers** in OpenGL, introduced with the ARB_buffer_storage extension in OpenGL 4.4, allow a buffer to remain mapped indefinitely. This technique is particularly useful for scenarios requiring frequent updates of data from the CPU to the GPU, such as particle systems or video frame updates. It reduces driver overhead and synchronization issues, making it a key component of the "Approaching Zero Driver Overhead" (AZDO) techniques.

**Persistent mapping** enables you to map a buffer once and retain the pointer for continuous updates without unmapping. This eliminates the need for repeated mapping and unmapping operations, reducing the number of OpenGL calls and synchronization overhead.

## Issueへのリンク

Addresses review feedback from #179: https://github.com/TetsuOtter/TRViS/pull/179#discussion_r2573323985

## 実装した機能の説明

WebSocket再接続ロジックのバグ修正。破棄済みのWebSocketインスタンスに対して`ConnectAsync`を呼び出すと`ObjectDisposedException`が発生する問題を修正。

## 仕様の説明

再接続時の動作:
- WebSocketが閉じられている場合、古いインスタンスを破棄
- 新しい`ClientWebSocket`インスタンスを作成
- KeepAliveオプションを設定後、接続を試行

変更内容:
- `_WebSocket`フィールドから`readonly`修飾子を削除（再代入を許可）
- `ConfigureWebSocketOptions()`メソッドを抽出し、初回接続と再接続で設定を共通化

```csharp
// Before: ObjectDisposedException発生
_WebSocket.Dispose();
await _WebSocket.ConnectAsync(_Uri, cancellationToken); // 破棄済みインスタンス

// After: 新しいインスタンスを作成
_WebSocket.Dispose();
_WebSocket = new ClientWebSocket();
ConfigureWebSocketOptions(_WebSocket);
await _WebSocket.ConnectAsync(_Uri, cancellationToken);
```

```yaml
permissions:

jobs:

This pull request introduces environment variable support to the server, making it easier to configure the application for different environments. The main changes include adding a `.env.example` file, integrating the `dotenv` package, and refactoring the server and model service to use environment variables for configuration.

**Environment variable support and configuration:**

* Added a `.env.example` file with configuration options for the model API, server port/host, and environment mode.
* Added the `dotenv` package to dependencies and required it in `server.js` to load environment variables. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-7ae45ad102eab3b6d7e7896acd08c427a9b25b346470d7bc6507b6481575d519L25-R26) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-a4c65ede64197e1a112899a68bf994485b889c4b143198bac4af53425b38406fR1)

author: yoy123
body:
## Summary
This PR enables reliable Twitter/X profile detection by using Twitter's syndication API.

## Changes
- Added `url_probe` pointing to Twitter's syndication endpoint
- Changed `errorType` from `unknown` to `errorMsg`
- Added `errorMsg` to detect non-existing profiles via `"hasResults":false`

## How It Works
Twitter's syndication API (used for embed widgets) returns a JSON response with a `hasResults` field:
- **Existing profile:** `"hasResults":true`
- **Non-existing profile:** `"hasResults":false`

### API Endpoint
```
https://syndication.twitter.com/srv/timeline-profile/screen-name/{username}
```

## Testing
Tested with multiple profiles:
| Username | Expected | Result |
|----------|----------|--------|
| @elonmusk | exists | `"hasResults":true` ✅ |
| @jack | exists | `"hasResults":true` ✅ |
| @github | exists | `"hasResults":true` ✅ |
| @thisisnotarealuser12345xyz | doesn't exist | `"hasResults":false` ✅ |
| @zzzznotreal99999 | doesn't exist | `"hasResults":false` ✅ |

## Caveat
Protected/private accounts with no public tweets will return `"hasResults":false` even though the account exists. However, this is still a significant improvement over the previous `unknown` state, as most users are looking for public profiles.

## Before/After
- **Before:** Twitter/X profiles showed as yellow (unverified/unknown)
- **After:** Twitter/X profiles show as green (confirmed) or not shown (doesn't exist)

- New toggle buttons: "☁️ GCP: ON" and "🔄 A2A: ON"

## Summary

Fixes #254

This PR addresses the `AttributeError: 'AnyUrl' object has no attribute 'startswith'` bug in the `handle_read_resource` function. The MCP SDK sometimes passes Pydantic `AnyUrl` objects instead of plain strings, causing the error when string methods are called.

## Changes

- **Bug Fix** (commit d494015): Added automatic URI string conversion at the beginning of `handle_read_resource`
- **Version Bump** (commit 179aee7): Updated version to 8.42.1 in all four required files
- **Dependency Lock** (commit 30f81c8): Updated `uv.lock` for v8.42.1

### Files Modified
- `src/mcp_memory_service/server.py` - Added AnyUrl to string conversion
- `src/mcp_memory_service/__init__.py` - Version bump to 8.42.1
- `pyproject.toml` - Version bump to 8.42.1
- `CHANGELOG.md` - Added v8.42.1 entry with bug fix details
- `README.md` - Updated Latest Release section
- `uv.lock` - Dependency lock update

## Technical Details

The fix uses a safe conversion approach:
```python
# Convert AnyUrl to string if necessary (fix for issue #254)
# MCP SDK may pass Pydantic AnyUrl objects instead of plain strings
if hasattr(uri, '__str__'):
    uri = str(uri)
```

This ensures compatibility with both string and AnyUrl inputs while maintaining backward compatibility.

## Testing

Manual testing confirms the fix resolves the AttributeError when using `fetch_mcp_resource`:
```python
print(default_api.fetch_mcp_resource(server="user-memory", uri="memory://stats"))
```

Expected behavior: Successfully returns memory statistics in JSON format without errors.

## Checklist

- [x] Bug fix implemented and tested
- [x] Version bumped in __init__.py, pyproject.toml, README.md
- [x] CHANGELOG.md updated with bug fix details  
- [x] uv.lock updated
- [x] No breaking changes
- [x] Backward compatible with existing code

## Summary

Fixes #1036 - Mummy Gameline: Add CRUD views for characters and locations

This PR adds proper permission controls to the Mummy gameline's existing CRUD views, following the patterns established in the Hunter gameline implementation.

### What was done:

**Character Views:**
- Added `ViewPermissionMixin` to MummyDetailView and MtRHumanDetailView (via HumanDetailView inheritance)
- Added `EditPermissionMixin` with limited form support to MummyUpdateView and MtRHumanUpdateView
- Added `VisibilityFilterMixin` to MummyListView and created new MtRHumanListView
- Added `select_related()` for query optimization in list views
- Created `LimitedMummyEditForm` and `LimitedMtRHumanEditForm` for owner editing

**Location Views (Tomb, CultTemple, UndergroundSanctuary):**
- Added `ViewPermissionMixin` to all detail views
- Added `LoginRequiredMixin` to all create views
- Added `EditPermissionMixin` to all update views

**Item Views (MummyRelic, Vessel, Ushabti):**
- Added `ViewPermissionMixin` to all detail views
- Added `LoginRequiredMixin` to all create views
- Added `EditPermissionMixin` to all update views

**Additional Changes:**
- Created MtRHuman list template
- Added URL routing for MtRHumanListView
- Added tests for update view permissions
- Increased Human age max validator from 500 to 5000 for ancient Mummy characters

This pull request introduces significant improvements to the AWS deployment guide project, focusing on deployment automation, infrastructure upgrades, and enhanced user experience. The changes include a new conditional deployment workflow, upgrades to AWS GitHub Actions, frontend UI enhancements, and expanded documentation.

**Deployment Automation and Infrastructure**

* Added a new `.github/workflows/check-deploy.yml` workflow to conditionally deploy to AWS ECS or GitHub Pages based on the `DEPLOY_AWS` secret, enabling flexible deployment strategies.
* Updated `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` to use `workflow_dispatch` instead of `push` triggers, and upgraded all AWS GitHub Actions to their latest major versions for improved reliability and compatibility. * Major redesign of the main landing page (`aws-deploy-guide/src/app/page.tsx`): introduced background gradients, improved hero section, a prominent GitHub repository link, and a streamlined layout for deployment steps and project links.
* Enhanced project descriptions in `ProjectLinks.tsx` to better reflect the scope and complexity of each DevOps project.

**Documentation and Technical Configuration**

* Fully rewrote the `README.md` to provide a comprehensive, illustrated deployment walkthrough and updated CI/CD documentation, making the guide more accessible and educational.
* Updated Next.js configuration (`next.config.ts`) to support static export and unoptimized images for compatibility with GitHub Pages.
* Added new dependencies (`react-icons`, `baseline-browser-mapping`) in `package.json` and `package-lock.json` to support improved UI and browser compatibility. ## Summary
> 에러 페이지 추가, 한글 입력 너비 수정, 타이핑 애니메이션 속도 최적화

## Changes

### ![feat](https://img.shields.io/badge/feat-green) 에러 페이지 추가 및 한글 입력 너비 수정
- 404 Not Found 페이지 추가 (터미널 스타일 UI, 3초 카운트다운)
- 500 Error 페이지 추가 (retry 버튼, 5초 카운트다운)
- Global Error 페이지 추가 (root layout 에러 처리)
- 에러 발생 시 자동 리다이렉트 (같은 도메인이면 뒤로가기, 아니면 홈으로)
- 터미널 한글 입력 시 너비 계산 수정 (charCode > 127 = 2ch)

### ![perf](https://img.shields.io/badge/perf-ff6b35) 타이핑 애니메이션 속도 최적화
- whoami/cat about.json 타이핑 속도 2배 향상
- 전체 애니메이션 시간 ~2.7초 → ~1초로 단축

Move the phase1 (Discovery & Cloning) module from phases/mod.rs
to a dedicated discovery.rs file. This reduces mod.rs size and

author: princethakur931
body: ## 📄 PDF Thumbnail Generation Feature ### Overview This PR implements automatic PDF thumbnail generation for uploaded documents. Thumbnails are pre-generated during upload and displayed in the collection list view for faster loading and better visual representation. ### Changes Made #### New Files - **`app/Services/ThumbnailService.php`** - Core service for PDF thumbnail generation - Supports both Imagick and Ghostscript + GD library - Generates 200x200px JPEG thumbnails from first page - Stores at `storage/app/public/doc-thumbnails/{collection_id}/{document_id}/` - **`app/Console/Commands/RegenerateThumbnails.php`** - Artisan command - Usage: `php artisan SR:RegenerateThumbnails {collection_id}` or `all` - Bulk regeneration with progress bar - Based on RebuildElasticIndex command structure #### Modified Files - **`app/Document.php`** - Added `getThumbnailUrl()` method - returns thumbnail URL or null - Added `hasThumbnail()` method - checks if thumbnail exists - **`app/Http/Controllers/DocumentController.php`** - Integrated thumbnail generation in upload process - Auto-generates thumbnails for PDF uploads - Non-blocking (upload succeeds even if thumbnail fails) - **`app/Traits/Search.php`** - Modified document list display logic - Shows PDF thumbnails when available - Falls back to default PDF icon if not present - **`config/filesystems.php`** - Enabled `public` disk for thumbnail storage - **`composer.json`** - Added `spatie/pdf-to-image` package (v3.1.0) ### Features ✅ **Automatic thumbnail generation** - Creates thumbnails during PDF upload ✅ **Graceful fallback** - Uses Ghostscript + GD if Imagick unavailable ✅ **Batch regeneration** - Command to regenerate entire collections ✅ **Smart display** - Shows thumbnails in list view with fallback to icons ✅ **Organized storage** - Clean directory structure per collection/document ✅ **Non-blocking** - Upload succeeds even if thumbnail generation fails ### Testing - Tested with GD + Ghostscript combination - Thumbnails generate successfully on upload - `SR:RegenerateThumbnails` command working correctly - List view displays thumbnails properly ### Requirements - **PHP GD extension** (enabled) ✅ - **Ghostscript** (installed at `C:\Program Files\gs\`) ✅ - **Storage link** created (`php artisan storage:link`) ✅ ### Usage ```bash # Regenerate thumbnails for specific collection php artisan SR:RegenerateThumbnails 2 # Regenerate thumbnails for all collections php artisan SR:RegenerateThumbnails all ``` ScreenShot / Testing Output:

Implements lazy-loaded client relationships display in the equipment item body, consuming the `/api/Relaciones` endpoint when an item is expanded.

### Changes

- **New `RelacionClienteDto` model** - Maps API response fields: `idRelacion`, `idCliente`, `razonSocial`, `nombreComercial`

- **New `IRelacionService` / `RelacionService`** - HTTP service consuming `GET /api/Relaciones?identificador={id}&idCliente=0` with auth handler

- **Extended `EquipoDto`** - Added `Relaciones` collection, `IsLoadingRelaciones`, `RelacionesLoaded`, and computed `ShowNoRelacionesMessage` with proper change notifications

- **Updated `EquiposView.xaml`** - Added "Clientes Relacionados" section with nested `ItemsRepeater`, loading spinner, and empty state message

- **Updated `EquiposView.xaml.cs`** - Triggers `LoadRelacionesForEquipoAsync` on expand, caches results per equipment item

### UI Structure
```xml
<!-- Inside equipment body -->
<StackPanel>
    <TextBlock Text="Clientes Relacionados" />
    <ProgressRing IsActive="{x:Bind IsLoadingRelaciones}" />
    <ItemsRepeater ItemsSource="{x:Bind Relaciones}">
        <!-- RazonSocial, NombreComercial, IdCliente per item -->
    </ItemsRepeater>
    <TextBlock Text="No hay clientes relacionados" 
               Visibility="{x:Bind ShowNoRelacionesMessage}" />
</StackPanel>
```

author: kyleconroy
body:
## Summary

Adds a new `expander` package under `internal/x/expander/` that expands `*` expressions in SQL queries to explicit column names by preparing the query against a database.

### Features

- Expands `SELECT *` to explicit column list
- Preserves table prefix for qualified stars (e.g., `authors.*` → `authors.id, authors.name, authors.bio`)
- Handles `RETURNING *` in INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statements (PostgreSQL)
- Recursively expands CTEs, including dependent CTEs where later CTEs reference earlier ones
- Supports subqueries in FROM clause
- Database-agnostic design via `ColumnGetter` interface

### Supported Databases

- **PostgreSQL** - Uses `pgxpool` connection to get column metadata via `Prepare`
- **MySQL** - Uses forked driver (`github.com/sqlc-dev/mysql`) with `StmtMetadata` interface
- **SQLite** - Uses native `ncruces/go-sqlite3` API for column metadata

## Example

```sql
-- Input
SELECT * FROM authors

-- Output
SELECT id, name, bio FROM authors
```

```sql
-- Input (PostgreSQL)
WITH a AS (SELECT * FROM authors), b AS (SELECT * FROM a) SELECT * FROM b

-- Output
WITH a AS (SELECT id, name, bio FROM authors), b AS (SELECT id, name, bio FROM a) SELECT id, name, bio FROM b
```

## Test plan

- [x] PostgreSQL tests (14 test cases) - CTEs, RETURNING *, qualified stars
- [x] MySQL tests (8 test cases) - qualified stars, table-scoped expansion
- [x] SQLite tests (8 test cases) - basic expansion, qualified stars
- [x] COUNT(*) correctly left unexpanded across all databases
- [x] All tests pass with proper SQL formatting (spaces after commas)

body:
## Problem

PR #6 introduced URL rewriting but included three jq commands - two broken attempts followed by the working one. The first command failed with:
```
jq: error (at merged-registry/streams/v1/images.json.bak:0): split input and separator must be strings
```

This caused the publish job to fail.

## Solution

Removed the two broken jq commands and kept only the working one that:
1. Extracts appliance name from aliases (first alias without a slash, e.g., "nginx")
2. Uses the `arch` field from product metadata
3. Maps `ftype` to correct release asset filenames:
   - `incus.tar.xz` → `nginx-amd64-incus.tar.xz`
   - `squashfs` → `nginx-amd64-rootfs.squashfs`

## Testing

After this PR merges, the workflow should complete successfully and `incus launch appliance:nginx` should work.

### **User description** This PR implements GitHub bot commands that allow Pool Managers to allocate bounties and Contributors to request bounties directly within GitHub issue comments. This enables bounty management without leaving GitHub. What's New For Pool Managers Allocate bounties via comments: Comment /bounty or @roxonn bounty on any issue Supported currencies: XDC, ROXN, USDC Automatic verification: System verifies pool manager authorization on-chain Pool balance checks: Automatically checks if sufficient funds are available before allocation Success notifications: Bot posts formatted comments confirming bounty allocation with remaining pool balance For Contributors Request bounties: Comment /bounty or @roxonn bounty on any issue to request a bounty Optional amount suggestion: Can include suggested amount and currency (e.g., /bounty 10 XDC) Request tracking: All requests are stored in the database for pool manager review Notification system: Bot posts confirmation comments when requests are created Technical Implementation Database Schema bounty_requests table: Stores bounty requests from GitHub issue comments Tracks GitHub repo ID, issue ID, requester, suggested amount/currency Status tracking (pending, approved, rejected) Links to users for processing Command Parsing Supports multiple command formats: /bounty 10 XDC - Allocate 10 XDC /bounty - Request bounty (no amount) @roxonn bounty 25 ROXN - Allocate 25 ROXN @roxonn bounty - Request bounty (no amount) Webhook Integration Event: issue_comment (created) Processing: Asynchronous command processing Rate limiting: 1 minute cooldown per issue to prevent spam SSRF protection: Validates repository names before processing Security Features Repository registration verification Pool manager authorization (on-chain verification) SSRF protection for repository names Rate limiting (1 minute per issue) Input validation (amount, currency) Webhook signature verification (existing) Files Changed shared/schema.ts - Added bountyRequests table server/github.ts - Added parseBountyCommand, handleBountyCommand, postGitHubComment functions server/routes.ts - Added issue_comment webhook handler server/storage.ts - Added bounty request storage methods Bot Response Examples Successful Allocation: 🎯 **Bounty Allocated!**| Amount | Status | Pool Balance ||--------|--------|--------------|| **10 XDC** | ✅ Active | 90 XDC remaining |**How to earn this bounty:**1. Submit a Pull Request that fixes this issue2. Reference this issue in your PR (e.g., "Closes #123")3. Once merged, the bounty is automatically sent to your Roxonn wallet🔗 [View on Roxonn](https://app.roxonn.com/repos/owner/repo) Bounty Request: ) 📋 **Bounty Requested**@username has requested a bounty for this issue.**Suggested amount:** 10 XDCRepository maintainers can approve this request:- Comment `/bounty ` to allocate- Or visit [Roxonn Dashboard](https://app.roxonn.com/repos/owner/repo) Testing Command parsing tests (all variations) Currency decimal handling (XDC/ROXN: 18 decimals, USDC: 6 decimals) Edge cases (invalid commands, rate limiting, authorization) Blockchain integration verification Related Issue Closes #33 ___ ### **PR Type** Enhancement, Tests ___ ### **Description** - Implement bounty bot commands for GitHub issue comments - Support `/bounty` and `@roxonn bounty` syntax for allocations and requests - Parse commands with amount and currency (XDC, ROXN, USDC) - Handle pool manager authorization and balance verification - Add promotional bounties feature for marketing tasks - Create API routes for managing promotional bounties linked to registered repos - Support submission and review system with role-based access control - Enable contributors to submit proof links for promotional work - Comprehensive test coverage for bounty bot and blockchain integration - Unit tests for command parsing, authorization, and edge cases - Add `promotionalBounties` and `promotionalSubmissions` tables - Implement storage methods for CRUD operations ___ ### Diagram Walkthrough ```mermaid flowchart LR A["GitHub Issue Comment"] -->|Webhook| B["parseBountyCommand"] B -->|Allocate| C["Pool Manager Check"] B -->|Request| D["Create Bounty Request"] C -->|Authorized| E["Check Pool Balance"] E -->|Sufficient| F["allocateIssueReward"] F -->|Success| G["Post Success Comment"] C -->|Unauthorized| H["Post Error Comment"] E -->|Insufficient| H D -->|Success| I["Post Request Comment"] J["Promotional Bounties API"] -->|Create| K["promotionalBounties Table"] J -->|Submit| L["promotionalSubmissions Table"] J -->|Review| M["Update Submission Status"] ```

author: baleen37
body:
## Summary

전체 프로젝트 구조를 유지보수 관점에서 개선하는 리팩토링입니다.

Multi-agent 병렬 분석(아키텍처, 코드 품질, 의존성, 에러 핸들링)을 통해 설계하고, 3단계로 나누어 실행 중입니다.

### 완료된 작업

**Phase 1: 기반 작업**
- ✅ Phase 1.1: 에러 처리 통합 (CustomError 확장 및 일관된 사용)
- ✅ Phase 1.2: HTTP 클라이언트 통합 (중복 80 LOC 제거, BaseHTTPClient 생성)
- ✅ Phase 1.3: Config Editors 이동 (apis/ → services/config/editors/)

**Phase 2: 서비스 레이어 구축 (진행 중)**
- ✅ ProcessManager 추출 (LeagueClient에서 130 LOC 이동)
- ✅ PlatformResolver 추출 (플랫폼별 경로 관리 100 LOC 이동)
- ⏳ GameSettingsManager 추출 (예정)

### 주요 개선 사항

- **코드 감소**: 중복 제거 및 레이어 분리로 약 230 LOC 제거
- **아키텍처 개선**: Controllers → Services → Clients → Domain 레이어 구조
- **테스트 용이성**: 의존성 주입 패턴 적용
- **유지보수성**: 단일 책임 원칙 적용, God Object 분해 진행 중

### 하위 호환성

모든 public API는 동일한 시그니처를 유지합니다. 내부 구현만 변경되었으며, Deprecation 경고를 통해 점진적 마이그레이션을 지원합니다.

## Test plan

- [x] 모든 unit 테스트 통과
- [x] mypy 타입 체크 통과
- [x] ruff 린팅 통과
- [ ] E2E 테스트 (League 클라이언트 필요)

author: antoineaugusti
body:
Cette PR ajoute la configuration nécessaire pour exécuter les tests sur GitHub Actions.

L'idée est de rester dans l'écosystème GitHub mais aussi de voir si on a plus de stabilité dans les tests.

La partie checkout/compilation est extraite pour avoir 2 jobs :
- lint : credo, gettext, JS, SCSS. Prend environ 2 min.
- test : `mix test`. Prend environ 2 min 30s.

La séparation en 2 jobs permet de diminuer le temps d'exécution ⚡. Le mécanisme de cache est commun aux 2 jobs.

https://github.com/etalab/transport-site/pull/4989/commits/ed7c9c16e3b0a49c6ec9ef38368e06ca53de9629 est sans rapport avec la PR, mais nécessaire pour avoir un build 🟢

author: ishaileshpant
body:
## Summary

This PR completely redesigns the E2E report generation to decouple testing from rendering.

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────┐    ┌──────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────┐
│  Test Runner    │───▶│  Metrics Output  │───▶│  HTML Renderer  │
│  (Bash Script)  │    │  (JSON)          │    │  (Python)       │
└─────────────────┘    └──────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘
```

## Changes

### New Files
- `report/render.py` - Python renderer with all business logic
- `report/template.html` - Clean HTML template with `{{placeholders}}`
- `report/styles.css` - Modern dark theme styling
- `scripts/metrics/example.json` - Example metrics for testing
- `scripts/export-metrics.sh` - Helper to export metrics to JSON

### Updated Files
- `Makefile` - New commands: `test`, `render`, `serve`
- `README.md` - Comprehensive architecture documentation
- `.github/workflows/e2e-test.yml` - Uses Python renderer
- `.github/workflows/pages.yml` - Uses Python renderer

## Benefits

1. **Re-render without re-testing**: Change styling/template without running expensive tests
2. **Local = GitHub parity**: Same output locally and in CI
3. **Metrics persistence**: Historical metrics can be retained for trending
4. **Simpler debugging**: Isolate test issues from render issues

## Testing

```bash
# Render with example data (no test run needed)
make render-example
make serve
# Open http://localhost:8080
```

## Screenshots

Report renders correctly locally with all charts, metrics, and status badges.

# Description

PostgreSQL pgvector throws `syntax error at or near "<=>"` when creating vector indexes. The `createVectorIndex()` function was using distance operators (`<=>`, `<->`, `<##>`) directly in `CREATE INDEX` statements, but pgvector requires operator class names instead.

**Changes:**
- Added `INDEX_OPS` constant mapping distance functions to operator classes:
  - `COSINE` → `vector_cosine_ops`
  - `L2` → `vector_l2_ops`  
  - `INNER_PRODUCT` → `vector_ip_ops`
- Updated `createVectorIndex()` to use operator class names for index creation

`DISTANCE_OPERATORS` remains unchanged for query operations in `searchByVector()` where actual operators are required.

Fixes https://github.com/ortus-boxlang/bx-ai/issues/8

body:
Adds comprehensive support for Skills Development organizations targeting adult learners (18+), with a complete enterprise custom pricing system for the sales team.

## Skills Development Organization Type

- Added `skills_development` to organization type enum with SA-specific terminology (Learner, Facilitator, Programme, Skills Centre)
- Updated OrganizationSetup.tsx and RoleSelectionScreen.tsx with skills-specific roles and descriptions
- Dashboard configuration with role-based widgets:
  - **Learner** → `learner` hub: Announcements, Schedule, Assignments, Grades, Certifications
  - **Facilitator** → `instructor` hub: Same + Certificate issuance
  - **Sponsor** → `guardian` hub: Progress reports, Certificates
  - **Centre Director** → `admin` hub: Full organizational overview

## Database Migration

Migration file: `supabase/migrations/20251130_skills_development_organization_type.sql`

**New Tables:**
- `skills_programmes` - Programme management with NQF levels, SETA codes
- `programme_enrollments` - Learner enrollment tracking
- `skills_certificates` - Certificate issuance and verification
- `competency_assessments` - Individual competency unit assessments
- `enterprise_pricing_tiers` - Custom pricing tier reference for sales
- `enterprise_quotes` - Sales quote tracking system

**Helper Functions:**
- `get_learner_progress()` - Learner progress summary
- `generate_certificate_number()` - Auto-generate unique certificate numbers
- `calculate_enterprise_price()` - Automated pricing calculations

## Subscription Tiers

| Tier | Facilitators | Learners | Monthly Price |
|------|-------------|----------|---------------|
| Free | 2 | 30 | R0 |
| Starter | 5 | 100 | R499 |
| Premium | 20 | 500 | R999 |
| **Enterprise** | **Unlimited** | **Unlimited** | **Custom** |

## Enterprise Custom Pricing System

| Enterprise Level | Learners | Base Price | Per Learner | Annual Discount |
|-----------------|----------|------------|-------------|-----------------|
| Small | 501-1,000 | R1,499/mo | R2.50 | 15% |
| Medium | 1,001-2,500 | R2,499/mo | R2.00 | 18% |
| Large | 2,501-5,000 | R3,999/mo | R1.50 | 20% |
| XL | 5,001-10,000 | R5,999/mo | R1.00 | 22% |
| Mega | 10,001+ | R8,999/mo | R0.75 | 25% |

**Additional Discounts:**
- Multi-year contracts: +5-10%
- Government/NPO: +10%
- SETA-accredited: +5%
- Maximum combined discount: 40%

## Documentation

- `docs/SKILLS_DEVELOPMENT_DASHBOARD.md` - Complete implementation guide
- `docs/ENTERPRISE_PRICING_GUIDE.md` - Sales team pricing reference with examples, competitor comparison, and objection handling

## Run Migration

```bash
supabase db push
supabase db diff  # Verify no drift
```

author: rwalkerlewis
body: Add an example to calculate Coulomb stress distribution from slip on one fault in a pair of parallel faults, with options for snapshot image or ASCII output. This example demonstrates a fundamental concept in earthquake mechanics: how slip on one fault can trigger or inhibit slip on nearby faults. It provides a configurable tool for studying stress transfer patterns and is useful for educational purposes and basic research. ---

author: kcenon
body:
## Summary

Implements the `dicom_file` class for reading and writing DICOM Part 10 files as specified in DICOM PS3.10 and issue #13.

### Key Features
- Parse DICOM files from disk (`open()`) or raw bytes (`from_bytes()`)
- Validate 128-byte preamble and "DICM" prefix
- Automatic File Meta Information parsing using Explicit VR Little Endian
- Auto-generate File Meta Information when creating new files
- Write files to disk or encode to bytes
- Round-trip support for read -> modify -> write workflows

### Implementation Details
- Custom `result<T, E>` template for C++20 compatible error handling (std::expected is C++23)
- Explicit VR Little Endian encoding/decoding with proper 16-bit/32-bit length field handling
- Convenience accessors for Transfer Syntax, SOP Class UID, and SOP Instance UID

### Files Changed
- `include/pacs/core/dicom_file.hpp` - Header with class definition and result template
- `src/core/dicom_file.cpp` - Implementation of all file operations
- `tests/core/dicom_file_test.cpp` - Comprehensive unit tests
- `CMakeLists.txt` - Build configuration updates

## Test Plan
- [x] All existing tests pass (680 assertions in 46 test cases)
- [x] New tests cover reading, writing, creation, round-trip, and error cases
- [x] Tested file operations with both bytes and filesystem paths

Closes #13

author: copilot
body:
Implements seller sub-order management with filtering by status/date/buyer and CSV/XLSX export for order reconciliation and fulfillment workflows.

### Domain & Infrastructure
- Extended `IOrderRepository` with `GetFilteredShipmentsByStoreIdAsync` (paginated) and `GetAllShipmentsForExportAsync`
- Filter support: status, date range, buyer name/order number search

### Application Layer
- Added `GetFilteredSellerSubOrdersQuery` and `ExportSellerSubOrdersQuery`
- New `OrderExportService` generates CSV/XLSX with: order ID, creation date, status, buyer info, total, shipping method

### UI
- Filter form with status dropdown, date pickers, search input
- Export dropdown (CSV/XLSX) respects current filters
- Paginated results (20/page)

```csharp
// Example: Get filtered orders for a seller
var result = await _orderService.HandleAsync(
    new GetFilteredSellerSubOrdersQuery(
        storeId,
        Status: "Paid",        // Focus on actionable orders
        FromDate: startDate,
        ToDate: endDate,
        BuyerSearch: null,
        PageNumber: 1,
        PageSize: 20));
```

### Screenshot
![Seller Orders with Filters](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/39f54d01-dfde-43f4-a108-b4e829f944b9)

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> 
> ----
> 
> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>Seller order list with filtering and export</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## Epic: Orders & Fulfilment
> 
> ## User Story
> As a seller I want to see a list of my sub-orders with filters and export so that I can manage fulfilment and reconcile orders with my internal systems.
> 
> ## Acceptance Criteria
> - Given I am logged in as a seller, when I open my orders section, then I see a paginated list of sub-orders that belong only to my store.
> - Given I have many sub-orders, when I filter by status, date range or buyer, then the list updates to show only matching sub-orders.
> - Given I need to process shipments in bulk, when I filter sub-orders by 'paid' or 'preparing', then I can focus on orders that require action.
> - Given I want to export my orders, when I choose export with a selected filter set, then the system generates an export file (e.g. CSV/XLS) containing at least order id, creation date, status, buyer, total amount and shipping method.
> - Given an export is generated, when the file is ready, then I can download it from the UI.
> 
> ## Notes
> - Export format should be compatible with common spreadsheet tools and potential ERP/WMS imports.
> - Access control: sellers must not see orders or buyer data for other sellers.
> - Large exports may require background processing and a download link rather than synchronous generation.
> </issue_description>
>

author: mairas
body:
## Summary

Fixes the package publishing pipeline by creating GitHub pre-releases that apt.hatlabs.fi can download packages from.

## Problem

The main workflow was building packages and dispatching to apt.hatlabs.fi, but apt.hatlabs.fi expects to download packages from a GitHub release. This architectural mismatch caused packages to never be published despite workflows reporting success.

**Evidence**: See [issue #19 investigation](https://github.com/hatlabs/halos-imported-containers/issues/19#issuecomment-3591991945) where apt.hatlabs.fi logs show:
```
No pre-release found for hatlabs/halos-imported-containers
```

## Changes

### 1. Updated Permissions
- Changed `contents: read` → `contents: write` to allow creating releases

### 2. Added Release Creation
- New step: "Generate release tag" - creates unique tags like `unstable-20251129-223045-a1b2c3d`
- New step: "Create pre-release" - uses `softprops/action-gh-release@v2` to create pre-release with all .deb files

### 3. Updated Dispatch Payload
- Added `release_tag` field to client-payload so apt.hatlabs.fi knows which release to download from

## Testing Plan

1. ✅ Workflow syntax validated
2. ⏳ PR checks will validate the workflow file
3. After merge: Monitor main workflow creates release
4. After merge: Verify apt.hatlabs.fi downloads from release
5. After merge: Confirm packages appear at https://apt.hatlabs.fi/dists/trixie-unstable/main/binary-all/Packages

## Expected Outcome

After this PR merges and is tested:
- Main branch builds will create pre-releases with .deb files attached
- apt.hatlabs.fi will successfully download packages from releases
- CasaOS packages will be available via `apt install casaos-container-store`
- Issue #19 will be resolved

Fixes #19

author: rajusudhar
body:
This PR lays the groundwork for the `atlassian-bitbucket-mcp` project, establishing a robust foundation with modern tooling and best practices.

### Key Changes:

- **TypeScript Setup**: Configured with strict mode, ES2022, and ESM modules.
- **Code Quality**:
    - **ESLint**: For code linting and style enforcement.
    - **Prettier**: For consistent code formatting.
    - **MarkdownLint**: To maintain documentation quality.
- **Git Hooks (Husky)**:
    - `commit-msg`: Enforces conventional commit messages.
    - `pre-commit`: Runs format, lint, and type checks.
    - `pre-push`: Validates branch naming conventions.
- **Automation Scripts**:
    - `sync-lock-files.sh`: Keeps `package-lock.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` in sync.
    - `validate-branch-name.sh`: Ensures consistent branch naming.
    - `check-package-security.sh`: Verifies dependencies against known vulnerabilities.
- **Structured Documentation**:
    - `ARCHITECTURE.md`: Outlines the system architecture.
    - `CODING-STANDARDS.md`: Defines coding best practices.
    - `BRANCH-MANAGEMENT.md`: Details branching strategy.
    - `SECURITY.md`: Describes security policies.
    - `PACKAGE-MANAGERS.md`: Explains dual-manager support (npm/pnpm).
- **Project Configuration**:
    - `.gitignore`, `.prettierrc`, `tsconfig.json`.
    - `.env.example` for environment variable setup.
- **License**: Added GNU GPL v3.0 license.

This foundational setup ensures a scalable, secure, and maintainable codebase from the start.

## Summary

- Change `MONITORING_WITH_THREAD_SYSTEM` default from OFF to ON (REQUIRED)
- Change `MONITORING_WITH_LOGGER_SYSTEM` default from OFF to ON (REQUIRED)
- Add `FATAL_ERROR` validation for required dependencies
- Add sibling directory fallback for dependency detection
- Keep `network_system` as optional to prevent circular dependency
- Update build summary to show dependency chain structure

## Dependency Chain (Option A Structure)

```
Tier 3: monitoring_system
  ├── common_system (Tier 0) [REQUIRED]
  ├── thread_system (Tier 1) [REQUIRED]
  ├── logger_system (Tier 2) [REQUIRED]
  └── network_system (Tier 4) [OPTIONAL - prevents circular dep]
```

## Changes

### CMake Options
| Option | Before | After |
|--------|--------|-------|
| `MONITORING_WITH_THREAD_SYSTEM` | OFF | ON (REQUIRED) |
| `MONITORING_WITH_LOGGER_SYSTEM` | OFF | ON (REQUIRED) |
| `MONITORING_WITH_NETWORK_SYSTEM` | OFF | OFF (unchanged) |

### New Features
- FATAL_ERROR if required dependencies are disabled
- Sibling directory fallback for `thread_system` and `logger_system`
- Improved build summary showing dependency chain

## Test plan

- [ ] Build with default options (should succeed with sibling dependencies)
- [ ] Build with `-DMONITORING_WITH_LOGGER_SYSTEM=OFF` (should FATAL_ERROR)
- [ ] Build with `-DMONITORING_WITH_THREAD_SYSTEM=OFF` (should FATAL_ERROR)
- [ ] Build with `-DMONITORING_WITH_NETWORK_SYSTEM=ON` (should succeed if network_system available)
- [ ] All existing tests pass

Resolves: DEP-002

author: jorhett
body:
## Why?

The helm chart currently creates a job to setup and update the schema named `temporal-schema-{{Helm chart version}}` since #564 which is often just `temporal-schema-1`. The lifetime of this chart is 1 day, which has two separate impacts:

* The chart must be manually deleted before an upgrade can occur 
  * #554
  * #735
* ArgoCD shows OutOfSync / Helm diff after Job expires
  * #636 
  * #709
  * #743
* Instructions say a user must run the upgrade, but the chart does it for you if `schema.update` is enabled
  * #737

## What was changed

1. Give the schema update job and pod a name including the major-minor version of Temporal. This will allow multiple minor version upgrades to succeed without having to manually remove the job.

2. Remove the job removal TTL the value of which was debatable, but regardless of value will show sync issues with  Helm diff and ArgoCD sync status. As the use of Helm hooks was explicitly removed in #522 to resolve issues with `--wait`, this provides another way to retain diff/sync. This also means that job update logs are retained and available for life of the helm release.

3. Updated the README to make it clear the manual update steps aren't required if update is enabled.

## Checklist

1. Closes #554 #735 #636 #709 #737

3. How was this tested: it's only a name change, helm upgrade did it all 😁 

5. Any docs updates needed?

Updates to the README are included.

VDDH is typically connected to USB (~5V) or directly to a battery. Measuring the voltage on VDDH is a way to measure the current battery voltage, which in turn can be useful to determine how much power is left in the battery.

I've special cased the nrf52840 in a somewhat unusual way, maybe there is a better way, feel free to comment!

---

This PR also contains a few small code cleanups, see the commit log for details.

author: lenucksi
body:
## Security Enhancement 🔒

Hi, amazing HA addition you've built for adaptive-lighting. I tried to run it locally for dev purposes and ran into a few sharp edges, as well as unobvious decisions in the setup.
I had Claude assist me in getting the repo set up for development purposes and fix the sharp edges. These PRs contain some patches that might be useful for you. Use or discard as you see fit. The usual ultra verbose Claude description below, take it with a grain of salt.

In this case:
- Enable automatic GitHub Actions digest pinning in Renovate to protect against supply chain attacks.

### The Problem

Currently, workflows use mutable version tags:
```yaml
uses: actions/checkout@v6
```

**Security Risk:**
- Tags can be force-pushed or deleted
- Attackers could modify code behind existing tags
- No way to verify exact code version

### The Solution

Add one line to `.github/renovate.json`:
```json
"extends": [
    "config:recommended",
    "helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests"  // <-- New
]
```

This tells Renovate to automatically pin actions to commit SHAs:
```yaml
uses: actions/checkout@1af3b93b6815bc44a9784bd300feb67ff0d1eeb3 # v6
```

### How It Works

1. **This PR**: Adds the Renovate configuration
2. **Renovate runs**: Creates PRs to pin existing actions
3. **Future updates**: Automatically include digest pins
4. **Zero maintenance**: Fully automated

### Security Benefits

| Before | After |
|--------|-------|
| `@v6` (mutable) | `@1af3b93b...` (immutable) |
| Can be changed | Cannot be changed |
| Trust on faith | Verifiable via SHA |
| Vulnerable to tag attacks | Protected |

### Real-World Attack Example

**Codecov Bash Uploader Breach (2021):**
- Attacker compromised Codecov's script repository
- Modified script at version tag to steal secrets
- Affected thousands of projects using `@v1` tag
- **Digest pinning would have prevented this**

[Read more](https://about.codecov.io/security-update/)

### Industry Standards ✅

This change aligns with:

- **OpenSSF Scorecard**: [Token-Permissions](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/main/docs/checks.md#token-permissions) check
- **SLSA Framework**: [Level 2](https://slsa.dev/spec/v1.0/levels#build-l2) requirements
- **GitHub Security**: [Best Practices](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-guides/security-hardening-for-github-actions#using-third-party-actions)
- **NIST**: Supply chain security guidelines

### What Happens Next

After merging, Renovate will:

1. Create PRs to pin all existing GitHub Actions
2. Each PR will show:
   - Old: `uses: actions/checkout@v6`
   - New: `uses: actions/checkout@1af3b93b... # v6`
3. You can review and merge at your pace

### Impact Assessment

- ✅ **No breaking changes** - Actions work identically
- ✅ **No workflow modifications needed** - Renovate handles everything
- ✅ **No secrets or configuration needed** - Just this one line
- ✅ **Improved security posture** - Industry best practice
- ✅ **Better compliance** - Meets security framework requirements

### Example Renovate PR

After this merges, Renovate will create PRs like:
```
Title: "⬆️ Update actions/checkout digest to 1af3b93"

- uses: actions/checkout@v6
+ uses: actions/checkout@1af3b93b6815bc44a9784bd300feb67ff0d1eeb3 # v6
```

You can review the exact code changes by visiting the commit SHA link.

body:
<!--
Thanks for creating this pull request 🤗

Please make sure that the pull request is limited to one type (docs, feature, etc.) and keep it as small as possible. You can open multiple prs instead of opening a huge one.
-->

<!-- If this pull request closes an issue, please mention the issue number below -->
Closes #5502

<!-- Add an introduction into what this PR tries to solve in a couple of sentences -->

This PR fixes an issue where trailing commas in JSON objects or arrays were not detected as invalid JSON in the request body editor. The server rejected such bodies, but the editor did not highlight the error. This change updates the parser to properly detect and report trailing commas with accurate error positions.

### What's changed
<!-- Describe point by point the different things you have changed in this PR -->

- Added explicit trailing comma detection in `parseObj` and `parseArr`.
- Store the comma token range before consuming it with `expect(",")`.
- When the next token after the comma is a closing `}` or `]`, report a `SyntaxError` pointing to the comma token rather than the closing bracket/brace.

- The fix is strictly scoped to JSON trailing comma handling.
- No existing behavior for valid JSON structures is affected.
